candidates.name: OGC API - Common Standard
verified_facts: OGC API Common defines reusable building blocks and core requirements for OGC Web APIs.
It standardizes API structure and conformance patterns across geospatial web services.
semantic_limits: API conformance establishes interface behavior, not the accuracy, currency or provenance of the underlying parcel elevation data.

candidates.name: OGC API - Records Standard
verified_facts: OGC API Records standardizes web access and query of metadata records describing geospatial resources.
Records support discovery and sharing of related geospatial resources and their descriptive information.
semantic_limits: A metadata record can establish discovery/provenance context but is not itself a parcel geometry or elevation measurement.
